subject: Retention package exception request: Sr SWE (org realignment)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Retention exception request: Sr SWE (org realignment)

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Following up from 1:1s this week — I need a one-time retention package sign-off for a senior SWE on my team (IC track) who is at high flight risk after the recent product org realignment. The manager-level performance score is "Meets & Often Exceeds" but the reorg moved the role to a larger scope and comp band misalignment now exists.

As discussed with People Ops, proposed ask is:
- $40k one-time spot cash (paid in next payroll cycle)
- 0.15% equity refresh (4-year vest, standard schedule)
- No base salary change today (we keep in-band adjustment on the roadmap)

Rationale (short): candidate received a counteroffer from NimbusAI (SaaS competitor) citing immediate sign-on equity + accelerated vesting. This is a retention-sensitive engineer on infra routing — replacement risk high.

Attachments: comp-exception-form.pdf (completed), org-change-summary.png, proposed-package.xlsx

Requesting:
1) Triage approval to move to formal Finance + Legal review (IANA)
2) If possible, expedited approval by EOD Mon so we can close before NimbusAI starts the process with the candidate.

Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Retention exception request: Sr SWE (org realignment)

Thanks Marissa — I appreciate the write-up and the urgency. A couple quick asks before I escalate to Finance/Legal:

- Can you confirm the current comp band and total cash + equity percentile (50/75/90) for this employee?
- Is there an alternate (smaller) package that would achieve the same retention outcome?
- Are there any prior exceptions for the manager's team in the last 12 months?

If you can send answers and a one-page candidate risk summary I will take it to Laura + Vivek for a fast track review. If we need to move faster I can also approve a limited pre-approval to allow People Ops to start paperwork while Finance runs numbers.

Ping me if you want to discuss now.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 10:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — I appreciate the write-up and the urgency. A couple quick asks before I escalate to Finance/Legal:
>
> - Can you confirm the current comp band and total cash + equity percentile (50/75/90) for this employee?
> - Is there an alternate (smaller) package that would achieve the same retention outcome?
> - Are there any prior exceptions for the manager's team in the last 12 months?

Hi Marcus — answers inline below and attached short risk summary.

- Current comp band: IC3 (Band 5 equivalency). Total cash + equity percentile ~ 65th internal; off-market benchmark shows this person at ~45th vs NimbusAI counteroffer.
- Alternate package: $25k one-time + 0.10% equity would likely close 70% of cases; full $40k + 0.15% is recommended for the specific retention signal we've observed (active recruiter outreach + informal offer details).
- Prior exceptions: none in the past 12 months for this hiring manager's org.

I've updated proposed-package.xlsx to show the alternate scenario and included a short note from the manager on business impact.

If you give me pre-approval to begin Finance intake, I'll route the packet to Vivek and Legal and loop in the manager for a short justification call.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Retention exception request: Sr SWE (org realignment)

Agree with Marissa's recommendation given retention risk and no recent exceptions. Marcus — please provisionally approve the alternate package ($25k + 0.10%) if Finance needs a lower-band pre-approval to start paperwork immediately.

Vivek — please review the packet and confirm any accounting constraints or amnesty requirements. If Legal needs to add vesting language (clawback or accelerated vesting terms), please flag asap.

Laura

Subject: Approval: retention exception (Sr SWE) — limited pre-approval granted

Marissa / Marcus / Laura —

Finance has reviewed the proposed numbers and the alternate scenario. Given the business-critical risk and the lack of prior exceptions, Finance will approve the alternate package ($25,000 one-time, 0.10% equity) as a fast-track pre-approval to allow People Ops to begin paperwork.

Conditions and notes:
- Final payout will require completed comp-exception-form.pdf with manager sign-off and People Ops intake ticket WRKD-4821.
- Equity refresh will use standard grant paperwork; Legal to add a 12-month clawback clause in the event of voluntary departure within 6 months.
- If we determine later that the larger package ($40k / 0.15%) is necessary, Mari will return with additional justification and we will re-evaluate; any uplift requires CFO sign-off.
- DocuSign packet prepared: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF123456 (no-reply@docusign.com will send on People Ops' trigger).

Marissa — please confirm manager availability for the short sign-off call and route the packet to procure-payments@vendorpay.example.com for payroll coordination. I'll mark this as approved for accounting on our month close, subject to the above conditions.

—Vivek
